name: Himekouji Haruka
source:
She is the most popular girl in the academy because of her beauty and friendly personality.

Haruka has turned down countless girls' confessions who wanted to "engage" with her. She is interested in love, but she doesn't have much interest in pseudo-love between girls.

She is the first to reach out to Yuuri when he becomes stiff in front of everyone, and she has been Yuuri most reliable friend since then.

She is extremely popular, but she has enrolled in the late courses; a "Customer." It seemed like she was having a hard time letting her consciousness slip away and that she was creating a wall for the people around her to confess (engage) their feelings to her again, and she was secretly worried about it.

She is an ordinary girl dreaming of an ordinary romance.

[Translated from [url=https://www.moon-stone.jp/product/ms20/chara.html#haruka]official website[/url]]
